newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy CPI to fall despite oil price rise - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy CPI to fall despite oil price rise - Ciampi.

text.p: Italian inflation will fall further next month despite the recent increase in oil prices, Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Thursday.
"Despite the fact that oil prices have risen to $25 a barrel, annual inflation is now at 3.0 percent and next month it will be below this level," Ciampi said in a speech.
Inflation in September was 3.4 percent year-on-year. Official October data is due early next month. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
